title: Diagnose source-file watcher credit refusals despite unchanged endpoint hashes and mtimes
outcome: Diagnose source-file watcher credit refusals despite unchanged endpoint hashes and mtimes
acceptance: Record an evidence-based trace for source-file watcher refusals 2, 3 and 5 through raw notification ingress, workspace/root routing and check settlement. Distinguish observed facts from hypotheses; name any unavailable raw kind, timing or writer attribution explicitly, and do not claim historical causation from endpoint hash/mtime equality.

Add bounded provenance sufficient to diagnose future source-file refusals (raw event kind and available attributes, observation/processing ordering, routed root and exact affected check identity), without file contents, unbounded retention, filesystem I/O under StateInner or invented process attribution. Coordinate shared watcher changes with the directory-only fix.

Demonstrate any proposed credit-behavior correction with a deterministic RED-first watcher-to-settlement regression and negative controls for real edits, write-then-restore, replacement and unresolved/late events. Genuine or uncertain source-file writes remain fail-closed; endpoint hash equality alone never waives credit. If the evidence establishes no safe behavioral correction, deliver the diagnostic improvement and explicitly retain the unresolved cause instead of suppressing events.

Deliver a frozen patch with focused watcher/carried-check regressions passing on the exact source and an independent read-only Codex/Claude review pair with no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding. Full landing gate and integration remain Merger's responsibility.
